 The Associate Director EPRM is responsible for
   

  

* Develop, maintain, and enhance elements of the EPRM framework, including processes, sub\-processes, and supporting systems. This includes full ownership of subprocesses, stakeholder management, and supporting the implementation of effective Ethics, Risk \& Compliance Programs within the organization.
* Drive synergies to harmonize risk management outcomes.
* Manage activities to reinvent the EPRM process and methodology.
* Ensure governance around adherence to TPC, Code of Ethics, and EPRM Guideline and Handbook by driving various governance forums, training, communication and engagement initiatives.


**About The Role**
**MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES**
* Manage and evolve the EPRM process and methodology, including stakeholder engagement, work plan definition, and accountability for outcomes.
* Continuously monitor and recommend process and system enhancements, to improve operational excellence and user experience.
* Provide strategic support and contribute to EPRM initiatives and risk management activities across Risk Areas, as needed.
* Take full responsibility for the EPRM program communication and change management including managing Change Governance forum, documentation and tracking.
* Manage EPRM configuration listings including version control and proper documentation.
* Manage SpeakUp cases related to External Partners and collaborate with Global SpeakUp Office in end\-to\-end handling of such cases.
* Close monitor external regulations / legislation impacting EPRM framework, and work towards adaptation of existing EPRM program to comply with evolving regulations.
* Perform gap assessment of existing EPRM framework with the emerging regulations.
* Engage proactively with internal stakeholders (Risk Functions, EPRM Operations), ERC Heads and support Country Presidents on cross\-divisional EPRM related governance topics.
* Advise and support business owner / legal/ procurement groups on implementation of EPRM contract toolkit and Novartis Third Party Code.
* Organize and manage stakeholder forums such as Risk Functions meetings, EPRM Champions network, etc.) to ensure open communication and collaboration among all stakeholders.
* Provide expert guidance to stakeholders (Business Owners, Risk Functions, EPRM Operations, etc.) on adherence to the contracting toolkit covering compliance requirements, negotiation support, and equivalency assessments to ensure consistent and risk‑aligned third‑party engagements.
* Drive organizational and operational readiness for emerging regulations by continuously monitoring regulatory developments, interpreting their impact, and leading cross‑functional efforts to adapt the EPRM framework, ensuring timely and effective compliance.


**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS / MEASURES OF SUCCESS**
* Project outcomes with positive impact on risk assurance, efficiency, and compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Stakeholder Feedback on communication and engagement including improvement on training.
* Effective implementation and continuous improvement of compliance and risk management processes.

* Project Management expertise.
* Strong communication and engagement experience leading change management, communication, and engagement initiatives working across stakeholders in a matrix environment.


**LANGUAGES**

title: Litigation Counsel – Collections & Recovery
description:
**Please Read How To Apply Section Carefully**
**ROLE**
**Litigation Counsel — Collections \& Recovery**
 In\-house seat to lead recovery litigation across group NBFC entities. The job is maximum rupees collected from defaulting and fraudulent counterparties — not maximum notices served, and not endless legal loops.
   

  

**WHERE**
 Mumbai. Hearings across NCLT, High Court, tribunals, magistrate / EOW, outstation courts.
   

  

**REPORTS TO**
 Business leadership. You own the recovery docket. External counsel reports to you.
   

  

**BOOK**
 \~35 live offensive matters \+ a small defensive criminal / notice book. Multi\-entity, multi\-forum.
   

  

**SUCCESS**
 Cash in. Encashable security. Accounts frozen. Assets attached. Days\-to\-control. Filings are inputs.
   

  

**THE WORK**
 You will design and run multi\-forum campaigns on each cluster of defaults: Section 9 interim relief (freeze, disclosure, attachment), Section 11 / 17 arbitration, NCLT admission and CoC strategy, police and EOW complaints, newspaper publication and service, asset tracing, and settlements that only close against security that can be encashed. You will also protect directors on the defensive docket with the same urgency.
   

  

 You will not be hired to issue legal notices and wait for the next listed date. You create the next event — mention, publication receipt, additional affidavit, Form D, police follow\-up, asset\-search sprint — and you stand up and argue the hearings that matter.
   

  

**What You Have Done**
* 5–10 years of dispute work with a recovery bias. You have personally argued in more than one of: NCLT, High Court (Sec 9 / 11\), arbitral tribunal, magistrate or EOW.
* At least one matter where your sequence of moves produced cash in the client’s account or attached / encashable security — not merely an award or an admission order.
* Comfort with the unglamorous work that wins orders: affidavits of service, newspaper originals, vakalatnamas, bank\-freeze follow\-through, IO visits.
* Judgement on when to settle (only with security) and when settlement is the other side’s delay tactic.
* Ability to run a panel of external counsel to your written brief, and to replace counsel who miss dates or go silent.
* Clear bright line between lawful pressure (court\-ordered publication, notices to authorities, asset disclosure) and anything that is defamation, intimidation, or a reckless counter\-FIR risk.


**What This Is Not**
 A notice factory. A research seat. A coordinator who outsources thinking to senior counsel and reports dates. A role for someone whose default move is ‘issue a legal notice and file a case.’ If you want a quiet drafting practice, do not apply.
   

  

**How We Work With You**
* Authority to brief and replace external counsel within budget; investigator and publication budget from week 1\.
* Settlement mandate below a stated threshold; above that, you bring the recommendation, not the paperwork after the deal is done.
* Vakalatnamas and affidavits signed by the company inside 48 hours. One source\-of\-truth tracker. Weekly 2 hours recovery stand\-up.
* Compensation: in\-house base plus variable tied to cash collected and enforceable security on named clusters — not to number of filings.


**How To Apply**
**Send (1\) CV and (2\) an 8\-line note on one matter you ran that produced cash or attached security. Name the forums, the non\-obvious move, and the result. Do not send a generic ‘I have handled IBC and arbitration matters’ paragraph. Shortlisted candidates will get a two\-page redacted case study before the second conversation.**

title: Legal Counsel & Company Secretary
description:
**THIS ROLE WILL REQUIRE YOU TO RELOCATE TO DUBAI** 




  





 About the Role
 



 We are seeking an experienced Legal Counsel \& Company Secretary to join a fast\-paced telecommunications business with operations across multiple international markets.
 



 The role will provide legal, corporate governance and company secretarial support across the Group, working closely with senior management, Board members, finance, regulatory, commercial and operational teams.
 



 The successful candidate will combine strong commercial legal capability with practical experience managing the governance and statutory requirements of a complex, multi\-entity international organisation. Experience within telecommunications, technology, digital services or another highly regulated international sector is strongly preferred.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Legal \& Commercial
 


* Provide practical legal advice to the Group and its international operating companies.
* Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including:
* Telecom and technology agreements
* Supplier and vendor contracts
* Distribution and channel agreements
* Customer and enterprise agreements
* IT, software, SaaS and technology agreements
* Outsourcing and managed\-service agreements
* NDAs, consultancy and professional\-services agreements
* Advise business teams on contractual risk, liability, indemnities, termination rights and commercial obligations.
* Support negotiations with major suppliers, partners, operators and other third parties.
* Work with regulatory and compliance teams on matters affecting telecommunications operations across different jurisdictions.
* Support the management of disputes, litigation and external legal advisers where required.
* Provide legal input into new market entry, corporate projects, restructurings, acquisitions and other strategic initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate legal controls, policies and contracting processes are maintained across the Group.



 Company Secretarial \& Corporate Governance
 


* Act as a key point of contact for company secretarial and corporate governance matters across the Group.
* Maintain oversight of the Group's legal entity structure across multiple jurisdictions.
* Manage statutory registers, corporate records and governance documentation.
* Coordinate Board and shareholder meetings, including:
* Preparing agendas
* Collating and distributing Board papers
* Drafting Board and shareholder resolutions
* Preparing and maintaining accurate meeting minutes
* Tracking actions and decisions
* Ensure required statutory filings and corporate submissions are completed accurately and within relevant deadlines.
* Manage director appointments, resignations, changes of officers, registered offices and other corporate changes.
* Coordinate incorporations, dissolutions, restructurings and changes to Group entities.
* Maintain appropriate delegated authorities, powers of attorney and authorised signatory records.
* Support annual corporate compliance requirements across international subsidiaries.
* Liaise with local counsel, company secretarial providers, corporate service providers and government authorities internationally.
* Ensure subsidiaries comply with applicable corporate governance requirements and Group policies.



 Board \& Senior Management Support
 


* Provide governance advice to the Board, Chairman, CEO and senior management as required.
* Ensure Board decisions and corporate approvals are appropriately documented and implemented.
* Advise management on corporate authority, governance processes and director responsibilities.
* Support the development and implementation of Group governance frameworks, policies and procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive Board, shareholder and corporate information.



 Candidate Profile
 



 The successful candidate should ideally have:
 


* Qualified lawyer status in a recognised jurisdiction.
* Approximately 8–15\+ years' relevant legal experience, although exceptional candidates outside this range will be considered.
* Strong commercial legal and contract negotiation experience.
* Demonstrable company secretarial and corporate governance experience.
* Experience supporting Boards and senior executives.
* Experience managing multiple legal entities across several countries.
* Strong understanding of corporate structures, statutory filings, Board governance and subsidiary management.
* Experience within telecommunications, MNO, MVNO, technology, digital or another regulated international business is highly desirable.
* Exposure to international regulatory and compliance environments.
* Ability to coordinate multiple external legal and corporate service providers across jurisdictions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities.
* Commercially minded, pragmatic and comfortable operating in a fast\-moving international environment.



 Preferred Experience
 



 Particular interest will be given to candidates with experience in:
 


* Multi\-country corporate structures
* International subsidiary governance
* Board and shareholder governance
* Commercial telecom and technology contracts
* Corporate restructuring and entity rationalisation
* Regulatory and compliance matters
* International expansion and new\-market entry
* Working directly with CEOs, CFOs, General Counsel and Boards



 Key Success Measures
 



 Success in the role will be measured through:
 


* Effective governance of the Group's international legal entities.
* Accurate and timely completion of statutory and corporate requirements.
* High\-quality Board and shareholder governance.
* Commercially effective legal advice and contract negotiation.
* Reduction of legal, contractual and governance risk.
* Strong visibility and control of corporate obligations across all jurisdictions.
* Effective management of external legal and company secretarial providers.



 The Opportunity
 



 This is an opportunity to take a significant legal and governance role within a global telecommunications organisation, providing exposure to multiple jurisdictions, Boards, senior leadership and complex international commercial and corporate matters.
 



 The position would suit a commercially minded lawyer who combines strong legal capability with hands\-on company secretarial and corporate governance expertise and is comfortable operating across a diverse international business.

title: Companies Secretary
description:
**About the job** 




**Job Title: Companies Secretary (CS)** 




**Location:** 
 Green Park, Delhi
 



**Company:** 
 Sangal \& Associates
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 qualified CS (freshers welcome) as well as candidates with prior experience may apply.
 



**Salary:** 

 50,000 to 1,00,000 (depending on experience)
 




  





**About Us** 




 Sangal \& Associates is a Chartered Accountancy firm based in Delhi NCR, advising companies, alternative investment funds, start\-ups and promoter groups in India and overseas.
 



 Our practice spans statutory, internal and tax audits; direct and indirect taxation; transfer pricing and international taxation; business and securities valuations; corporate structuring and restructuring; FEMA and RBI compliances; secretarial and ROC compliance; due diligence and transaction advisory; and litigation and representation before tax and regulatory authorities.
 



 Working with us means exposure to cross\-border assignments, funds and fast\-growing businesses, close working contact with the partners, and the breadth that comes from a practice that is not confined to a single vertical.
 



  





 We are looking for a Company Secretary to join our team on a full\-time, onsite basis.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Handle end\-to\-end secretarial compliance under the Companies Act, 2013 — incorporations, ROC/MCA filings, maintenance of statutory registers and records.
* Convene and document Board Meetings, Committee Meetings, AGMs and EGMs — drafting notices, agendas, resolutions and minutes.
* Conduct and support Secretarial Audits, due diligence and compliance health checks for clients.
* Manage FEMA/RBI compliances and filings, including FC\-GPR, FC\-TRS, Form InVi, FLA Return and ODI/FDI reporting.
* Support valuation and transaction advisory assignments — share allotments, transfers, buy\-backs, restructuring, ESOP schemes and related documentation.
* Draft and vet agreements, undertakings, declarations, board resolutions and other legal/secretarial documentation.
* Liaise with clients, ROC, RBI, authorised dealer banks and other regulatory authorities.
* Track regulatory amendments and advise clients and internal teams on their impact.
* Maintain compliance calendars and ensure timely closure of all statutory due dates.



**Requirements** 



* Qualified Company Secretary (Member of ICSI); candidates who have completed CS Executive with relevant experience may also be considered.
* Working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, FEMA and allied corporate laws.
* Sound drafting skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in MS Office and MCA/RBI online filing portals.
* Ability to manage multiple client assignments and deadlines independently.
* LLB or additional qualification will be an added advantage.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
**Role:** 
 AM/ Manager \- Legal Counsel
 



**Experience:** 
 Min 4\-5 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Noida, Sector 62
 



**Salary Range:** 
 10LPA \- 13LPA (Hike on previous CTC)
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and commercially astute Legal Professional to join our core Legal Team. The role will involve handling a diverse portfolio of real estate transactions, contract lifecycle management, regulatory compliance, and dispute resolution.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong legal drafting and negotiation skills, practical exposure to real estate and property matters, and the ability to independently manage pre\-litigation matters and legal documentation while protecting the company's business interests.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 1\. Contract Management
 



 Manage the end\-to\-end contract lifecycle, including drafting, reviewing, negotiating, executing, and maintaining commercial agreements.
 



 Draft and review agreements to ensure appropriate risk allocation and protection of the company's interests.
 



 Work closely with business and internal stakeholders to identify and mitigate contractual risks.
 



  





 2\. Real Estate \& Leasing
 



 Draft, review, negotiate, and execute Lease Deeds, Leave \& License Agreements, Sale Deeds, Maintenance Agreements, and other property\-related documents.
 



 Support real estate transactions, including documentation and property\-related legal requirements.
 



 Assist with property due diligence and identification of legal risks associated with real estate transactions.
 



  





 3\. Legal Documentation
 



 Draft and vet Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Vendor Agreements, Service Agreements, and other commercial contracts.
 



 Ensure consistency of contractual terms with company policies and applicable laws.
 



  





 4\. Pre\-Litigation \& Dispute Resolution
 



 Draft and respond to legal notices, default notices, termination notices, and other legal correspondence.
 



 Develop and manage pre\-litigation strategies in coordination with internal stakeholders and external legal counsel.
 



 Handle out\-of\-court settlements, negotiations, and mediation to resolve disputes effectively and commercially.
 



  





 5\. Litigation Support
 



 Assist in preparation of matters for litigation, arbitration, and other legal proceedings.
 



 Coordinate with and brief external counsel on ongoing disputes.
 



 Track litigation matters across relevant courts, tribunals, and forums, ensuring timely follow\-up and documentation.
 



  





 6\. Legal \& Regulatory Compliance
 



 Ensure real estate transactions and documentation comply with applicable local land laws, property laws, RERA regulations, and other relevant statutory requirements.
 



 Conduct legal research and provide practical advice to business teams on applicable laws and regulatory requirements.
 



  





**Key Qualifications \& Skills:** 



* LL.B. / LL.M. from a recognized university.
* Strong working knowledge of Real Estate, Property, Contract, and Commercial Laws.
* Practical experience in property due diligence and real estate transactions.
* Strong drafting and reviewing skills, particularly in Service Agreements, Lease Deeds, Leave \& License Agreements, MOUs, SLAs, and Vendor Contracts.
* Experience handling pre\-litigation matters, legal notices, dispute resolution, and settlement negotiations.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple matters simultaneously, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong attention to detail and a commercially practical approach to legal risk management.

title: Junior Company Counsel
description:
**Are you passionate about supporting legal operations and delivering high\-quality legal documentation in a fast\-paced global business?**
**Would you enjoy working with a collaborative legal team where your drafting, contract management, and organisational skills can make a meaningful impact?**
**About Our Team**
 In this role, you will work with the company's compliance and litigation attorneys on compliance investigations, participate in compliance training development and delivery, assess and develop compliance policies, and manage aspects of an anti\-bribery due diligence program. You will also be asked to support one of the company’s sales segments with customer negotiations and transactions, which may dovetail with compliance insights and tasks.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Legal Professional, you will support a wide range of legal and commercial activities, including drafting, reviewing, and managing contracts and legal documentation. You will work closely with legal colleagues and business stakeholders to ensure documents are accurate, compliant, and delivered within required timelines. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to legal operations, contract management, and special projects while supporting a global business environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Prioritize and manage work effectively under tight schedules while maintaining excellent organisational standards.
* Produce, amend, and format accurate legal documents, letters, reports, presentations, spreadsheets, and other business documentation.
* Take, prepare, distribute, and maintain meeting minutes where required.
* Summarize legal documents and correspondence.
* Draft legal documentation, including contracts from approved templates and contractual provisions under guidance from senior legal professionals.
* Proofread legal documents to ensure consistency, accuracy, formatting compliance, and correct cross\-referencing.
* Review and update clauses across legal templates as needed.
* Support legal projects and other initiatives as requested.


**Requirements**
* Experience working within a legal team in either a law firm or in\-house legal environment.
* Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a variety of commercial contracts.
* Ability to prioritize and manage workload effectively to meet deadlines.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills with the ability to draft and review legal documents.
* Knowledge of legal terminology and legal principles.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Report writing and project management skills would be advantageous.
* Experience using software, systems, applications, or AI tools relevant to legal practice is preferred.


**Work in a Way That Works for You**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

**Working Pattern**
* Working remotely from home up to 3 days a week and in our office in a hybrid style
* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times you work in the day
* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


**Working for You**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

title: General Counsel
description:
**About the Role** 




 Wingify and AB Tasty are building one of the world's leading experimentation and digital experience platforms, helping thousands of businesses globally create better digital experiences and drive measurable growth.
 



 With a global footprint spanning
 **India, France, the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, Spain, Australia, Singapore, Canada, and Israel** 
 , the Group operates across multiple legal, regulatory, and commercial environments.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **General Counsel/VP – Legal \& Compliance** 
 to establish and lead the Group's global Legal \& Compliance function.
 



 This is a unique opportunity to join the executive leadership team and
 **build the legal function from the ground up** 
 —shaping the organization's approach to commercial contracting, corporate governance, privacy, compliance, intellectual property, risk management, and strategic transactions.
 



 The ideal candidate will be both
 **strategic and hands\-on** 
 : someone who can advise the CEO and Board on complex matters while also building scalable processes, frameworks, and a high\-performing legal organization.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 As the Group's senior\-most legal leader, you will be responsible for providing legal and strategic guidance across the business while building a scalable global legal infrastructure.
 



 You will partner closely with the
 **CEO, CFO, Board, and senior leadership team** 
 , as well as Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, HR, Security, and other functions.
 



  





**Your key areas of ownership will include:** 




**Commercial \& Technology Law** 



* Lead the drafting, negotiation, and execution of enterprise SaaS and technology agreements, including MSAs, DPAs, NDAs, licensing agreements, partnership and reseller agreements, and vendor contracts.
* Partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, and other teams to provide practical, commercially focused legal guidance.
* Build scalable contract templates, negotiation playbooks, approval frameworks, and legal workflows.
* Establish processes that enable faster business execution while appropriately managing legal and commercial risk.
* Manage external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions and optimize legal spend.
* Oversee disputes, claims, demand notices, and litigation, working toward commercially balanced outcomes.



**Corporate Governance \& Secretarial** 



* Lead corporate governance and company secretarial matters across the Group's global entities.
* Oversee board meetings, resolutions, statutory registers, regulatory filings, and governance documentation.
* Advise on corporate structuring, investments, reorganizations, and strategic transactions.
* Support M\&A activities, including due diligence, transaction documentation, and post\-transaction integration.
* Coordinate with local legal and corporate secretarial advisors across jurisdictions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable corporate and regulatory requirements across the Group.



**Privacy, Compliance \& Regulatory Affairs** 



* Own and continuously strengthen the Group's global privacy and compliance framework.
* Lead privacy and regulatory initiatives covering
 **GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act** 
 , and other applicable regulations.
* Oversee the Group's Data Protection Officer (DPO) function.
* Establish privacy\-by\-design and data governance practices across products and business operations.
* Develop and maintain privacy notices, policies, DPAs, internal compliance frameworks, and related documentation.
* Monitor regulatory developments and translate them into practical business recommendations.
* Represent the organization, where appropriate, before regulators and oversee responses to regulatory inquiries, audits, and compliance matters.



**Intellectual Property \& Technology** 



* Develop and execute the Group's IP strategy across trademarks, copyrights, patents, software, and other technology assets.
* Advise on SaaS licensing, technology partnerships, AI\-related legal matters, and emerging technology risks.
* Oversee open\-source software compliance and technology\-related legal frameworks.
* Protect and manage the Group's intellectual property portfolio and enforcement strategy.



**Legal Risk \& Disputes** 



* Develop an enterprise\-wide legal risk management framework.
* Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate material legal and regulatory risks.
* Oversee litigation, disputes, investigations, claims, and external counsel.
* Provide senior leadership with clear, commercially grounded recommendations on complex and emerging risks.



**Leadership \& Business Partnership** 



* Build, lead, and scale a high\-performing global Legal \& Compliance function.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the
 **CEO, CFO, Board, and executive leadership team** 
 .
* Establish legal operating models, processes, KPIs, and governance mechanisms aligned with business priorities.
* Develop legal and compliance awareness across the organization through training and enablement.
* Present material legal, compliance, governance, and risk matters to executive leadership and the Board.
* Build strong relationships with external counsel, regulators, advisors, and other strategic stakeholders.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **12–18 years of post\-qualification legal experience** 
 , with significant experience in senior in\-house legal leadership roles.
* Experience working within a
 **global technology, SaaS, software, internet, or similarly complex business environment** 
 .
* LLB or equivalent law degree required; LLM or relevant postgraduate qualification is a plus.
* Qualification to practice law in India is preferred/required depending on the candidate's primary jurisdiction.
* Strong expertise in
 **commercial contracting, technology law, corporate governance, privacy, and regulatory compliance** 
 .
* Deep working knowledge of
 **GDPR** 
 and familiarity with
 **India's DPDP Act, CCPA** 
 , and other global privacy frameworks.
* Proven experience managing legal matters across multiple international jurisdictions.
* Strong exposure to
 **M\&A, due diligence, corporate restructuring, investments, shareholder arrangements, and strategic transactions** 
 .
* Experience with intellectual property, software licensing, SaaS agreements, and open\-source compliance.
* Experience building or scaling an in\-house legal function is highly desirable.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance legal risk with business objectives.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior executives and Boards.
* Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.
* **French language proficiency and/or experience working with European businesses is a strong advantage.**



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In your first
 **12–18 months** 
 , you will:
 


* Establish a scalable global Legal \& Compliance function and operating model.
* Create consistent legal, contracting, governance, privacy, and compliance frameworks across the Group.
* Improve the speed, consistency, and effectiveness of commercial contracting.
* Strengthen the organization's global privacy and regulatory compliance posture.
* Build strong partnerships with executive leadership and business teams.
* Establish an effective approach to legal risk management and external counsel.
* Support strategic business initiatives, investments, and M\&A.
* Build and develop a strong legal team capable of supporting the Group's continued global growth.



  





**Why This Role?** 




 This is
 **not a traditional legal leadership role** 
 .
 



 You will have the opportunity to shape the legal function of a growing global technology group, work directly with executive leadership, influence strategic decisions, and build the systems and team that will support the organization's next phase of international growth.
 



 If you are a commercially minded legal leader who enjoys
 **building, solving complex problems, and enabling business growth—not simply managing legal risk—we'd love to hear from you.** 




  





  





**Job Location:** 
 Gurugram / Delhi NCR. Candidates based in or willing to relocate to the Delhi NCR region are preferred.

title: Litigation Manager (4-5 years)
description:
Position Overview
 



 Delhivery is looking for a law graduate with 4–5 years of relevant litigation experience to join its Litigation team in Gurugram. The role involves independently managing litigation filed by or against Delhivery across India — commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil and criminal matters — including reviewing notices received, drafting and vetting replies, notices, written statements and evidence, and formulating and recommending strategy on the way forward for current and existing matters. The candidate will monitor all pending litigation; coordinate with internal business and ground teams to gather evidence and inputs for replies, notices, written statements and other court/tribunal filings; and manage and coordinate with external counsel, including assigning new matters and overseeing how they are handled. The ideal candidate will have sharp legal acumen and the ability to strategise, and will be resourceful, organised and people\- oriented, with strong follow\-up skills and the ability to manage cases independently with minimal supervision.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Litigation Management \& Drafting
 



 • Independently manage and respond to commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil and criminal matters across India; review notices received and draft, vet and finalize replies, notices, written statements, pleadings and evidence before filing.
 



 • Take the call on assigning matters to external counsel, driving litigation strategy, filings and hearings, and proactively flag risks and escalations to management.
 



 • Track litigation timelines, monitor court proceedings, maintain accurate, up\-to\-date trackers and ensure timely resolution of issues such as AR attendance, document filing and orders with external counsel.
 



 2\. Evidence \& Internal Coordination
 



 • Coordinate with internal departments (HR, Security, Finance, Revenue Assurance) and business/ground teams to obtain accurate data and factual inputs; manage, protect and collate evidence for use in replies and pleadings.
 



 • Draft responses independently or route them to counsel, and review counsel\&\#39;s drafts for accuracy and alignment with the company\&\#39;s position before filing.
 



 • Act as the primary liaison between the Litigation team, internal stakeholders and external counsel; drive timely documentation, appearances and compliance across functions.
 



 3\. Counsel \& Court Coordination
 



 • Coordinate with external counsel for hearings, filings, conferences and documentation, representing the Litigation team\&\#39;s interests throughout.
 



 • Facilitate execution of affidavits, vakalatnamas and authorisations, and coordinate attendance of company representatives and witnesses before courts and authorities, ensuring adequate preparation.
 



 4\. Strategy, Team \& Operations
 



 • Strategise and advise business teams on legal escalations and potential litigation, recommending a course of action based on risk assessment; identify recurring issues and recommend process or policy changes.
 



 • Own day\-to\-day litigation operations, calendars, document repositories, litigation reports, counsel invoices and court\- fee approvals and drive improvements in tracking and document management.
 



 Qualifications ; Experience
 



 • LL.B. from a recognised university or institution.
 



 • 4–5 years of relevant litigation or litigation\- management experience (in\-house or law firm) across commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil or criminal matters.
 



 • Demonstrated experience independently managing litigation end\-to\-end, with minimal supervision.
 



 • Familiarity with court procedures, particularly in Delhi/NCR.
 



 • Proven experience coordinating with external counsel and internal stakeholders on case strategy.
 



 • Ability to independently navigate court and tribunal
 



  





 Key Skills Attributes
 



 • Sharp legal acumen with strong drafting and reviewing skills across notices, pleadings and
 



 evidence.
 



 • Resourceful, proactive and solution\-oriented, with the confidence to own matters and a small team independently.
 



 • Strong analytical ability and sound judgment in assessing litigation risk and strategy.
 



 • Excellent follow\-up skills and the ability to drive closure of action items across stakeholders.
 



 • Clear, confident communication skills, both written and verbal
 



 • Bar Council enrolment preferred.
 



 • High level of organization, attention to detail and ownership.
 



 • Ability to manage multiple matters, a small team and competing priorities under pressure.
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and litigation trackers; high integrity and professionalism.

title: Global Financial Crimes Compliance Risk Assessment Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The American Express Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC) function provides second\-line policy, framework, oversight and control solutions to meet the Company’s legal, regulatory and risk management mandates in connection with Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter Terrorism Financing (CTF), Sanctions, and Anti\-Bribery and Corruption. The GFCC portfolio comprises all aspects of the Company’s first and second\-line financial crime risk management (FCRM) activities, including all lines of businesses in the United States and both proprietary and non\-proprietary global markets.
   

  

 Reporting to the Vice President of Financial Crime Risk Assessment, Reporting \& Controls Oversight, this Manager role is responsible for supporting the Financial Crime Risk Assessment (FCRA) framework, including risk assessment delivery, reporting, and fundamental assessments. Specifically, this role will support each of the FCRA processes with pre\-planning and execution activities focused on data requirements, collection, analysis and tracking, implementing and maintaining data quality controls, and developing action plans to address data issues. The FCRAs play a critical role in delivering transparent, data\-driven insights into inherent and residual risks, strengthening the control environment, and supporting effective governance and decision\-making across the enterprise. Through close partnership with stakeholders across lines of defense, technology, product, and business teams, this role enhances a foundational component of the risk assessment process, improving the accuracy of results and risk visibility in alignment with evolving regulatory expectations and ongoing transformation initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Build governance structure and oversee the end\-to\-end process of data collection, tracking, analysis, documentation, issues, and quality controls used in the production of enterprise, market, legal entity, and line\-of\-business FCRAs.
* Develop and implement data quality controls and associated documentation of enhanced processes and procedures in FCRA processes.
* Manage engagement with key stakeholders across Business Units, GFCC, Market Compliance, Technology and Product teams to obtain requisite data.
* Develop and maintain documented data and input requirements, including data owners, data sources, extraction scripts, report names, and other details required to develop a consolidated data inventory of risk assessment inputs.
* Define and implement data attestation process, data tracker and issues log to enable effective and accurate data collection, including documentation of known limitations, anomalies, data manipulations, and data issues that may impact the quality or accuracy of data.
* Analyze FCRA data and results to identify emerging risks, issues, trends, and year\-over\-year changes; translate insights into actionable recommendations and methodology enhancements.
* Support outcomes of risk assessments and development of risk assessment action plan based on data issues.
* Support senior management, audit, and regulatory engagements through high\-quality, defensible analysis and documentation.
* Partner with GFCC Enablement, Technology and Product teams to support delivery of enhancements to risk assessment platforms and data infrastructure. Perform assessments to evaluate and mitigate impacts to existing reports stemming from platform modernization, technology and process changes.
* Provide subject matter expertise on financial crime risk assessment, reporting, and controls, strengthening governance and risk management practices.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team, fostering accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* 5\+ years of work experience in data management, analytics and/or reporting within Financial Crimes Compliance, Risk Management, or general Compliance.
* Demonstrated expertise in data management, including data collection, organization, validation, and maintenance to ensure accuracy, consistency, and accessibility across systems and platforms.
* Demonstrated experience in AML/CTF programs, or broader financial crimes risk management, including execution of enterprise risk assessments.
* Expert MS Excel skills (e.g., Pivot tables, Macros, Power Query) and/or demonstrated experience using data visualization tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, or MicroStrategy is required. Proficiency in SQL and/or other data querying languages is preferred, with the ability to design, review, and optimize complex queries to extract, analyze, and validate large datasets.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly articulate complex risk and control concepts to a range of audiences and translate findings into impactful reports, communications and presentations to senior management, committees, regulators, etc.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Decisive self\-starter with a high degree of accountability, solution\-focused and able to successfully balance multiple priorities over both the short and long term in a deadline\-intensive environment.
* Ability to initiate and drive projects to completion, navigate ambiguity and proactively anticipate and address challenges.
* Strong management, collaboration, organizational, and interpersonal skills with ability to motivate and engage team\-members and stakeholders to ensure effective delivery of initiatives.
* Experience supporting regulatory exams, audits, or internal reviews, including preparation of defensible documentation and responses.
* Experience working across global, matrixed organizations and partnering effectively with Compliance, Risk, Audit, Technology, and business stakeholders.
* Proven to have a global mindset; able to work well across time zones and work cultures.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.

From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

 As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals \- people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Overall Purpose of The Job**
* The Technical Compliance Specialist is responsible for supporting the effective monitoring of technical compliance across managed vessels within the Operations Support Centre (OSC).
* The role ensures vessels maintain high standards of technical reliability, preventive maintenance, and regulatory compliance through structured monitoring of defects, maintenance routines, inspection findings, vessel certification, and technical reporting. In addition to compliance oversight, the role supports ship management teams in coordinating key class surveys, statutory services, and class\-related compliance matters to ensure vessels remain fully compliant with classification society requirements, statutory regulations, and company standards.
* Through proactive monitoring, analysis, and coordination with ship management teams, the Technical Compliance Specialist contributes to maintaining fleet technical readiness and reducing operational and regulatory risks.


**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**
**Technical Compliance Monitoring**
* Monitor defect management across assigned vessels and highlight critical or overdue defects to the Ship Management team for timely resolution.
* Monitor compliance with critical spare parts requirements to ensure vessel reliability and operational readiness.
* Monitor adherence to critical planned maintenance routines and ensure timely execution onboard.
* Conduct oversight of routine planned maintenance activities to ensure maintenance schedules are followed.


**Inspection \& Findings Monitoring**
* Monitor Vessel Inspection Reports (VIR) and track progress on corrective actions.
* Monitor findings raised by Inspection Managers and ensure timely follow\-up and closure.
* Identify overdue or recurring findings and escalate where required.


**Certification \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Monitor the validity and compliance status of vessel trading certificates.
* Monitor PMS\-related certification to ensure system compliance with company and statutory requirements.
* Track and monitor outstanding Conditions of Class (CoC) and support timely closure.


**Survey \& Class Compliance Coordination**
* In addition to monitoring responsibilities, the Technical Compliance Specialist supports ship management teams in coordinating key class and statutory compliance activities, including:
* Supporting the planning and coordination of Class Annual Surveys.
* Assisting with the planning and arrangement of Underwater Inspections (UWI).
* Assisting in the application and follow\-up of Conditions of Class (CoC) and dispensation requests where required.
* Supporting the planning and coordination of statutory services and inspections to ensure vessels maintain regulatory compliance.


**Technical Monitoring \& Analysis**
* Monitor and review Fuel Oil Analysis reports and highlight abnormal trends where identified.
* Monitor and review Lube Oil Analysis reports and escalate potential technical risks.
* Monitor annual sample analysis for systems including Ballast Water, OWS, Sewage Treatment Plant, Potable Water, and Scrubber Water (EGCS).


**Technical Documentation \& Reporting**
* Review Technical Month\-End Returns submitted by vessels to ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Review and circulate the Monthly Lube Oil (LO) Report to Accounts (TECH 06\) in a timely manner.
* Maintain accurate technical compliance records within company systems.


**Compliance Oversight \& Verification**
* Conduct random reviews of Bunker Plans to verify compliance with company procedures.
* Conduct random reviews of Oil Record Book (Part I) entries to ensure proper documentation and regulatory compliance.


**Systems, Risk \& Escalation**
* Utilize company systems including ShipSure, Technical Dashboards, Operational Risk Analysers, and VVP to monitor vessel compliance and identify potential technical risks.
* Escalate critical technical compliance gaps or statutory issues that may impact vessel safety, inspection outcomes, or regulatory compliance.

 Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose\-led business. Work with brands that are well\-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good.  The Legal Powerhouses are part of the legal function and provide defined, structured services to our other lawyers and to the broader business.
   

  

**Where This Position Fits\-into The Team**
* Part of the Unilever Legal Powerhouse – a team we’ve built which consists of around 60 colleagues in Bangalore
* Integral part of the Global Privacy Team \- a specialist legal team based across India, Mexico, USA, China, Spain, South Africa and the UK.
* Based alongside the Uni Ops Function in Bangalore – a wider team of 1,600 that powers Unilever’s strategy through world class business operations enabled by technology and innovation


**Role Purpose**
 This role will support and progressively lead privacy operations and advisory activities across defined areas of the business, combining strong privacy expertise with growing fluency in technology capabilities, digital processes and the interaction points between privacy and cyber risk management.
   

  

 You will act as a key contact for brands and functions navigating Unilever’s privacy processes, taking ownership of delivery and providing structured guidance to stakeholders, while escalating higher\-risk or complex matters. You’ll bring a practical understanding of how technology solutions operate in practice and when privacy issues should be managed within the privacy team, the cyber team or through coordinated hand\-offs across both.
   

  

 You’ll also support the effective operation of Unilever’s privacy programme, including Privacy Risk Assessments (PRAs), Data Subject Requests (DSRs), Records of Processing Activities (ROPAs), Incident Management and general compliance tracking, while contributing to continuous improvement and standardisation of processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 General Privacy Responsibilities
   

  

* Across all our core privacy processes, provide practical, process\-based privacy guidance to stakeholders, escalating complex or high\-risk issues to senior team members.
* Act as a primary point of contact for the Privacy Risk Assessments (PRA) process for stakeholders in the countries you support, independently managing lower\-to\-medium complexity PRAs and queries, and producing reports and metrics while monitoring cases to help ensure timely action.
* Provide strategic advice and support to Local Privacy Advisers in the countries you are Relationship Manager for on matters including records of processing activities (ROPAs), Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs), Incidents and privacy notice updates.
* Support negotiation of standard privacy clauses and contracts, following established playbooks.
* Contribute to implementation of privacy\-by\-design requirements in projects.
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
* Act as the primary point of contact to maintain the master Local Privacy Adviser Contact List, collaborating with the rest of the Global Privacy Team and local privacy advisers to ensure the list is reviewed at least quarterly and kept up\-to\-date.


**Global Network Support And Leadership**
* Responsible for building an effective bridge between the Global Privacy Team and local privacy advisers for the countries you are Relationship Manager for by providing strategic and operational support for complex and medium/high\-risk matters. Contribute to the agenda setting and updates for regional calls with participant countries you are Relationship Manager for.
* Produce and interpret regular reporting on trends, risks, and performance metrics to include in communications and updates to the global network.


 Continuous improvement and becoming the Privacy Team of the future
   

  

* Contribute to the development and enhancement of:


 O PRA guidance
   

  

 O Playbooks and templates
   

  

 O Operational processes
   

  

* Privacy Advisers of the future need to combine strong privacy knowledge with practical understanding of how technology works in the business, including digital tools, platforms, data flows and emerging technologies, alongside awareness of where privacy and cyber risks overlap and where clear hand\-offs are needed as part of effective internal risk management.
* Work effectively with technology, cyber, legal and business stakeholders to understand how systems and processes operate, identify where privacy risk may arise, and support practical risk management outcomes across shared responsibilities.
* Support the team’s ambition to become more data\-driven and scalable.
* Act as a role model for efficient, standardised ways of working and mentor junior members of the team in their day\-to\-day activities.


 Specialist Focus Area (specific to each individual in role)
   

  

* Training Design \& Delivery
* Contribute to the design of the overall strategy for privacy training across our global network of local privacy advisers. Responsible for delivery against the training strategy, including creation and dissemination of annual global privacy training. Use AI effectively to support the creation of training content, while applying sound judgement on what training should be delivered, in what format, and through which channel for different audiences and purposes.
* Contribute to the design of the Privacy SharePoint and the content within it. Responsible for ensuring the Privacy SharePoint and supporting materials are always up\-to\-date.
* Responsible for continuous training and monitoring of the Privacy SharePoint Agent overlay, including developing effective prompts and training approaches to help AI generate high\-quality, accurate and audience\-appropriate training content.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Legally qualified
* 3–5 years’ experience in data protection, privacy, or related compliance areas.
* Strong understanding of privacy compliance processes, including PIA and DSAR handling, with the ability to apply privacy requirements in an operational business context.
* Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders in a global environment.
* Demonstrated interest in and practical fluency with technology functionality and capabilities, including the ability to understand how systems, digital tools and data flows work in practice.
* Understanding of where privacy and cyber responsibilities overlap, interact or require hand\-off, and confidence working across teams to support clear and effective risk management.
* Demonstrated ability to own and deliver workstreams with limited supervision.
* Experience in project coordination or programme support.


**Desirable**
* Privacy certification (e.g. CIPP/E, CIPP/US).
* Exposure to multi\-jurisdictional privacy requirements.
* Exposure to technology, cyber security, digital risk or product counselling topics in a business environment.


 Leadership Behaviors
   

  

* Care deeply
* Focus on what counts
* Stay 3 steps ahead
* Deliver with excellence

title: Senior Manager - Data Privacy & Protection
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear \- to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
   

  

 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

**About the Role:**
 We are looking for a high\-agency Data Protection \& Privacy leader to drive end\-to\-end privacy, governance, and data protection initiatives across CoinDCX.
   

  

 This role will be responsible for identifying critical privacy and data governance gaps across business functions, building scalable compliance and risk mitigation frameworks, and ensuring execution that strengthens data security, regulatory adherence, user trust, and organizational resilience.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Design, plan, and execute activities to ensure compliance with UAE PDPL, DPDPA, ISO 27701, and other relevant data protection and privacy regulations and standards.
* Develop and implement processes to maintain ongoing compliance and readiness for external assessments and certifications.
* Drive data protection and privacy awareness activities through various channels such as mailers, digital posters, fliers, games, events, campaigns, and communications.
* Identify training requirements, develop and launch training programs, and ensure high completion rates across the organization.
* Conduct targeted data protection and privacy training sessions for different roles within the organization.
* Identify and manage data protection and privacy risks through risk assessments, collaboration with risk owners, and continuous risk reporting to management.
* Evaluate and monitor the effectiveness of data protection and privacy controls through internal audits and assessments, ensuring timely remediation of any identified gaps.
* Design, develop, and publish data protection and privacy policies, procedures, and guidelines, managing their lifecycle activities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including legal, compliance, engineering, operations, and security, to ensure data privacy compliance.
* Track and ensure timely publication of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) by respective internal stakeholders.
* Facilitate external audits in collaboration with internal stakeholders and auditors, ensuring timely closure of audit findings.
* Identify and escalate risks in third\-party engagements by conducting third\-party risk assessments for new requests and annual reviews, suggesting process improvements as needed.
* Manage data breach response planning and execution, if necessary.
* Develop dashboards and publish periodic reporting on data protection and privacy risks, internal control compliance, and audit/assessment findings to management.
* Continuously improve the data protection and privacy control framework and look for automation opportunities to reduce manual efforts in processes.
* Provide guidance and support to other team members and less experienced colleagues.
* Plan, design, and execute data protection and privacy assessment activities for mergers and acquisitions, providing regular status updates to stakeholders.
* Perform regulatory and statutory audit compliance activities with timely completion.


**You’ll Know You’re Winning When:**
* 7\-9 years of overall experience in the data protection and privacy domain with 6 years of relevant experience in managing data protection and privacy programs.
* Strong knowledge and implementation experience of data protection and privacy management frameworks, regulatory requirements, and applicable standards such as DPDPA, GDPR, ISO 27701, ISO 27001, etc.
* Demonstrated experience in conducting risk assessments, data protection and privacy assessments, internal audits, and facilitating/driving external audits.
* Solid experience in driving successful data protection and privacy awareness programs, activities, and training across the organization.
* Strong knowledge and experience in data protection and privacy governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong team player and collaborative problem solver, committed to achieving shared team goals and fostering a positive work environment.
* Strong verbal, written communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in managing tasks under time constraints, ad\-hoc work assignments, adept at independently reassessing priorities with attention to detail.
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and work towards a plan of action.
* Professional certifications such as ISO 27001 / ISO 27701 LA/LI, CIPM, CIPP/E, or other relevant certifications are a plus.
* Good knowledge or understanding of Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is an advantage.


 ﻿﻿﻿
   

  

**Hiring Process:**
 Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take\-home task or live problem\-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long\-term fit


**Where We Work:**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
   

  

 With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organisation. This role is based out of our
 **Bengaluru** 
 office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You:**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities


**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
 If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high\-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Basel Policy and Regulatory Reporting Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
 The Basel Policy and Regulatory Reporting function plays a critical role in ensuring that the Bank’s regulatory capital interpretations, capital calculations and regulatory filings are accurate, well controlled and compliant with applicable U.S. Basel III rules, while also assessing the impact of upcoming Basel III Endgame requirements to inform senior management decision\-making.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine strong technical knowledge of U.S. regulatory capital rules and regulatory reporting requirements with the ability to interpret complex regulations, execute and oversee capital calculations, evaluate new business activities and product structures, support implementation of regulatory change, and collaborate effectively with business, Finance, Risk, Regulatory Affairs, Technology, Audit and senior management stakeholders.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 The team plays an important role in the overall success of the organization by supporting accurate, compliant and decision\-useful regulatory capital outcomes. State Street is subject to both Standardized and Advanced approaches under the U.S. Basel III regulatory capital framework and is expected to maintain robust processes for interpreting capital requirements, calculating RWA and leverage exposure, producing regulatory filings and adapting to Basel III Endgame developments.
   

  

 In this role, you will help strengthen the Bank’s Basel program by connecting policy interpretation, capital analytics, data and controls, regulatory reporting execution and strategic regulatory change management in a manner that is scalable, well governed and responsive to business and supervisory expectations.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 The Basel Policy and Regulatory Reporting VP will primarily focus on the following areas:
   

  

* Regulatory policy interpretation and advisory:
+ Provide technical interpretation of U.S. Basel III regulatory capital rules, including Standardized and Advanced approaches, and assess the implications of Basel III Endgame developments.
+ Advise business units and functional partners on the capital treatment of new products, new activities, transaction restructurings and capital optimization initiatives.
+ Develop policy materials, interpretive memoranda and governance documentation addressing key regulatory capital matters.

* Capital analysis and regulatory change:
+ Monitor regulatory developments issued by the U.S. banking agencies and the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision and evaluate their impact on the Bank’s capital ratios, RWA and leverage exposure.
+ Participate in industry quantitative impact studies and collaborate with Regulatory Affairs and industry forums on proposed regulatory changes.

* RWA calculation and reporting:
+ Oversee monthly, quarterly and annual deliverables related to capital ratios, RWA calculations, exposure measurement and regulatory capital reporting.
+ Validate critical data elements used for exposure and RWA calculations across selected products and support close analysis, variance explanations and senior management reporting.
+ Prepare or review regulatory filings and disclosures, including FFIEC 101, FFIEC 102, FR Y\-14Q, FR Y\-9C, FFIEC 031, FR Y\-15 and regulatory capital disclosures in SEC filings, as applicable.

* Controls and data:
+ Maintain and enhance procedures, controls and documentation to support accurate and compliant capital calculations and reporting.
+ Support user acceptance testing of Risk Data Lake logic updates, new product onboarding and implementation of regulatory or reporting changes.
+ Identify potential weaknesses in capital treatments, calculations, data or processes; escalate issues; and drive remediation through completion.

* Governance, assurance and team leadership:
+ Support internal and external audit, assurance reviews and regulatory inquiries related to capital interpretation, calculation, reporting and controls.
+ Manage or contribute to the annual Advanced Systems Assessment and related cross\-functional governance activities.
+ Coach, mentor and develop team members while promoting cross\-training, knowledge expansion and consistent execution standards.


**What We Value**
 These skills will help you succeed in this role
   

  

* Advanced knowledge of U.S. regulatory capital rules, including Basel III, Basel III Endgame, Standardized and Advanced approaches, RWA, leverage exposure and related regulatory reporting requirements.
* Understanding of banking products, capital markets activities, GAAP concepts, risk management principles and regulatory reporting frameworks.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex regulatory, data and calculation matters and develop practical solutions.
* Experience managing projects, driving remediation, supporting implementation of regulatory change and executing deliverables under tight timelines in a controlled environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare executive\-ready materials and explain complex issues clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Strong relationship\-building skills and ability to collaborate across Finance, Risk, Business, Regulatory Affairs, Technology, Audit and other control functions.
* Leadership skills, including the ability to coach, mentor and develop team members while promoting accountability and high\-quality execution.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and similar tools; experience with data analysis, reporting platforms or technology\-enabled control environments is preferred.


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field
* Masters in Finance or Business Administration, CFA/CPA preferred
* 8\+ years prior experience in the banking and/or financial services industry with an advanced knowledge of banking industry products and services and capital markets activities
* Experience with U.S. Basel capital rules, RWA calculations, capital reporting, regulatory filings, governance documentation or regulatory change implementation preferred.


**About State Street**

title: IT Sourcing Manager
description:
**Job Title:** 
 IT Sourcing Manager
   

  

**Department** 
 : ISPL Cardif IT
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 BNP Paribas Cardif is a world leader in bancassurance partnerships, providing its customers with products and services that let them realise their goals while protecting themselves from unforeseen events. BNP Paribas Cardif is committed to having a positive impact on society and to making insurance more accessible. A subsidiary of BNP Paribas, the insurer has a unique business model anchored in partnerships. It creates solutions for more than 500 partner distributors in a variety of sectors – including banks and financial institutions, automotive sector companies, retailers and telecommunications companies – as well as for financial advisors and brokers who market the products to their customers. With a presence in 30 countries and strong positions in Europe, Asia and Latin America, BNP Paribas Cardif is a global specialist in personal insurance, the world leader in creditor insurance and a major contributor to financing for the real economy. With 9,000 employees worldwide, BNP Paribas Cardif had gross written premiums of €40\.5 billion in 2025\.
   

  

 BNP Paribas Cardif IT is a global organization with about 3000 IT staff across Europe, Latin America and Asia. Its mission is to drive and support our business strategy across all regions by leading digital transformation and delivering secure, resilient, and scalable industrial technology solutions. It is committed to enabling innovation, strengthening cyber resilience, and fostering collaboration and diversity across markets and teams to create exceptional value for our customers and partners, and ensure sustainable growth for BNP Paribas Cardif at the global scale.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 The IT Sourcing Manager is responsible for the commercial and contractual architecture of the India sourcing project. This role acts as the vital link between Onshore Beneficiaries (Business \& IT Managers) and the External Vendor Market. Your mission is to translate the technical and operational needs of our onshore stakeholders into high\-quality sourcing strategies, ensuring that the vendors selected provide the exact expertise, cost\-efficiency, and compliance.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Onshore Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirement Translation
* Beneficiary Alignment: Act as the primary commercial interface for Onshore IT Managers and Business Beneficiaries to understand their technical roadmaps and resource needs.
* Requirement Synthesis: Collaborate with onshore technical leads to translate complex functional and technical requirements into clear, commercially viable Sourcing Specifications.
* Sourcing Advisory: Advise onshore beneficiaries on market trends, pricing benchmarks, and the pros/cons of different delivery models (e.g., Managed Services vs. Staff Augmentation) to ensure their needs are met effectively.
* Strategic Sourcing \& Vendor Selection
* Market Intelligence: Conduct continuous research into the Indian IT landscape to identify high\-caliber service providers that align with BNP Paribas Cardif’s technical standards.
* RFP \& Tender Management: Lead the end\-to\-end Request for Proposal (RFP) process, ensuring that all technical criteria defined by onshore beneficiaries are rigorously evaluated during vendor selection.
* Sourcing Strategy: Execute sourcing decisions that balance technical excellence, cost\-optimization, and long\-term scalability.
* Negotiation \& Contract Management
* Commercial Negotiation: Lead negotiations on pricing structures, volume discounts, and contract terms to maximize value for the Group.
* SLA \& Contractual Governance: Ensure that all vendor contracts include robust Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that directly reflect the service quality expected by onshore beneficiaries.
* Contractual Compliance: Ensure all agreements strictly adhere to BNP Paribas Group procurement policies and global cybersecurity/risk standards.
* Vendor Relationship \& Financial Oversight
* Vendor Lifecycle Management: Manage the formal onboarding of new partners and the strategic exit/transition of legacy providers.
* Commercial Escalation: Act as the first point of escalation for any commercial discrepancies, contract breaches, or cost\-related deviations impacting the project budget.
* Cost Optimization: Partner with FinOps and Finance to monitor vendor spend and ensure the outsourcing model delivers the expected economic efficiency.


**Contributing Responsibilities**
**Recruitment \& Onboarding Execution**
* Demand Translation: Convert onshore technical requirements into detailed hiring plans (profile, timing, and priority).
* Talent Coordination: Orchestrate the end\-to\-end recruitment workflow within ISPL (screening, interviews, and offers) to ensure a seamless talent pipeline.
* Onboarding Management: Support the rapid onboarding of resources to meet project ramp\-up needs and ensure "day\-one" readiness.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Strategic Sourcing \& Procurement: Mastery of the end\-to\-end sourcing lifecycle (RFP, RFI, RFQ) within a complex IT environment.
* Contract Management: Deep understanding of commercial contract law, specifically regarding IT services, intellectual property, and data privacy.
* Vendor Risk Management (VRM): Ability to assess and mitigate third\-party risks in alignment with IT Risk Management and Cybersecurity frameworks.
* Financial Acumen: Proficiency in cost\-benefit analysis, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) modeling, and managing complex pricing structures.
* IT Domain Awareness: Foundational understanding of IT infrastructure, application development, and cloud services to communicate effectively with technical beneficiaries.


**Specific Qualifications**
* Stakeholder Influence \& Negotiation: Exceptional ability to manage expectations and negotiate effectively with both internal onshore beneficiaries and external vendor executives.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work seamlessly across IT, HR, Finance, and Procurement functions to achieve project goals.
* Analytical Thinking: Capability to synthesize complex technical requirements and market data into clear strategic recommendations.
* Communication Excellence: High proficiency in articulating commercial and strategic concepts to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment between onshore needs and offshore delivery.
* Integrity \& Professionalism: Unwavering commitment to ethical sourcing practices and compliance with Group standards.


**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**
* Strategic Sourcing/Procurement expertise
* Contract Law fundamentals
* Vendor Risk Management (VRM)
* Financial Modeling/Cost Analysis
* Familiarity with IT Service Management


**Behavioral Skills**
* Advanced Negotiation skills
* Strong Commercial Acumen
* Ethical Integrity
* Stakeholder Management
* Strategic ThinkingSkill


**Education Level:** 
 Master’s Degree
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8\+ years of experience
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach.
